name: Added sugars
what_is: Added sugars are sugars introduced into a food during processing or preparation rather than sugars naturally present in its ingredients.
why_botia: Added sugars are not the same as total sugars, and not every market requires them to be declared separately. BOTIA keeps a declared added-sugars value distinct from total sugars, free sugars and the ingredients that may contribute to it.
can_1: Read the added sugars value when it is declared on the nutrition label and preserve its unit and basis.
can_2: Keep added sugars separate from total sugars and other sugar-related fields.
can_3: Identify declared ingredients that may contribute added sugars.
can_4: Connect the declared value with the applicable regulatory information and documented evidence.
cannot_1: Calculate added sugars from total sugars when the label does not declare them separately.
cannot_2: Determine the exact amount contributed by each added-sugar ingredient.
cannot_3: Treat added sugars and free sugars as the same concept.
cannot_4: Treat an undeclared added sugars value as zero.
